subject.title: fix(context-engine): bound deferred turn maintenance with the compaction safety timeout

question: Should this PR continue as the maintenance-timeout fix, or should maintainers keep the compatibility-preserving per-task timeout design in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97175 as the canonical path?
rationale: Both PRs address the same session-stall class, but this branch changes the public plugin `maintain()` default while the existing candidate is proof-positive and default-off; automation cannot choose that product/compatibility policy.

options.title: Use compatibility-preserving timeout path
options.body: Require this PR to preserve current default behavior or align with the opt-in per-task timeout/fence approach before merge.

options.title: Accept unconditional maintain timeout
options.body: Maintainers can intentionally accept the plugin compatibility risk if they want `maintain()` bounded by the compaction timeout for all existing engines.

options.title: Close in favor of the canonical PR
options.body: If https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97175 remains the preferred landing branch, close this PR as a duplicate after linking the canonical candidate.

recommendation.title: Use compatibility-preserving timeout path
recommendation.body: Require this PR to preserve current default behavior or align with the opt-in per-task timeout/fence approach before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They merged the original background-maintenance feature and the plugin compaction timeout work, and are the clearest routing owner for the compatibility policy choice.
